title: Writing / Style / Conjunctions
slide_intent: Allow a sentence to begin conversationally so a short follow-up thought can retain its natural rhythm.
strategic_value: The conjunction-led birthday example can help Duolingo avoid unnecessary sentence merging.
demonstration: One checked example begins its second sentence with And after a celebratory first sentence.
practical_value: Keep an initial conjunction when it gives the next short sentence a natural connection.

content_islands.name: Worked examples

reference_purposes.Application: The approved birthday message begins its second sentence with And.
reference_purposes.Constraint: A sentence may begin with a conjunction such as and, but or or.
